stories.label: Iran war Day 9: US admits likely responsibility for school strike killing 168 children
stories.summary: Day 9: US military investigation finds American forces likely responsible for strike killing 168 children at Iranian girls' school. Israel launched 'broad-scale' strikes on Tehran infrastructure. Iran hit Tel Aviv with missiles. Iraqi militia claimed 27 attacks on US targets. Saudi intercepted missiles aimed at US troop base. New IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi appointed. Trump declared he should help pick Iran's next leader.

stories.label: Hormuz Day 9: US suspends own Russia sanctions to keep oil flowing amid war it started
stories.summary: Hormuz sealed Day 9. US granted India 30-day waiver to buy Russian oil — sanctions regime breaking under its own war. Oil up 5% Thursday. Trump: 'If gas prices rise, they rise.' UAE resuming limited flights. Oil dropped 2% Friday on Trump pledge to intervene in Hormuz.

stories.label: Lebanon: Bekaa Valley airstrikes, Hezbollah warns Israeli border towns to evacuate
stories.summary: Israeli jets bombing Bekaa Valley. Hezbollah warned Israeli residents within 5km of border to evacuate. Death toll climbing. NATO raised ballistic missile defence posture after Turkey-area attack. Lebanese public increasingly critical of Hezbollah.

stories.label: DRC: 200+ killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern Congo
stories.summary: At least 200 killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern DRC. Rescue operations likely ongoing.

stories.label: Anthropic vows to sue Pentagon over unprecedented 'supply chain risk' designation
stories.summary: Escalated from threats to litigation. Anthropic vows to sue Pentagon over 'supply chain risk' designation — first US company so designated. Cold War-era tool turned on domestic AI firm that refuses to waive safety restrictions for military use.

stories.label: US and Venezuela restore diplomatic relations after Maduro's ouster
stories.summary: US and Venezuela restored diplomatic ties. Acting President Delcy Rodriguez's government committed to 'new stage' based on 'mutual respect.' Venezuela's oil reserves strategically important amid Hormuz closure.

stories.label: Jimmy Lai accepts 20-year sentence, won't appeal Hong Kong national security conviction
stories.summary: Jimmy Lai, 78, decided not to appeal his 20-year conviction under Hong Kong's national security law. Longest sentence under the law. Founded Apple Daily. Appeal deadline expires Monday. British citizen.

stories.label: Indonesia and Pakistan leaders plan joint Tehran visit to mediate Iran war
stories.summary: Prabowo and Sharif planning joint Tehran visit to push for de-escalation while US bombs the city. 500 million Muslims represented. Indonesia also threatened to quit Board of Peace over Palestine.

stories.label: China plans world-first accelerator-driven nuclear reactor that burns radioactive waste
stories.summary: China about to fire up world-first accelerator-driven subcritical system (ADS). Burns spent nuclear fuel while generating energy. CAS claims 1,000-year energy source. Technology US and Europe studied but never built.

stories.label: US court orders $130B tariff refund; 24 states sue to block replacement tariffs
stories.summary: Federal judge ordered $130B+ tariff refund. Trump immediately imposed replacement 10% tariffs. 24 states now suing to block the new tariffs.

stories.label: Bahrain: Iranian attack hits Manama; regime continues arresting protesters
stories.summary: Iranian attack hit sites in Manama. First significant protests since 2011 continue. Authorities arresting people over social media posts. Shia majority, Sunni monarchy, US 5th Fleet base.

stories.label: Wikipedia forced into read-only mode after mass admin account compromise
stories.summary: Wikipedia forced into read-only mode after coordinated compromise of administrator accounts. Restoration status unclear.

stories.label: Nepal election: RSP leading in 36 seats, results emerging
stories.summary: RSP wins one seat, leading in 36 from early results. ~60% turnout. Full results expected within days.

stories.label: Pentagon orders Latin America to militarize against cartels
stories.summary: Pentagon chief Hegseth told Latin American defense officials 'business as usual will not stand' at first 'Americas Counter Cartel Conference.'

stories.label: Gaza: Aid collapses under Iran war cover — siege tightens unseen
stories.summary: Aid entirely cut off. Crossings sealed. Siege tightening while world watches Iran.

stories.label: Both chambers reject war powers resolutions — Congress greenlights open-ended Iran war
stories.summary: Both Senate and House rejected war powers resolutions. House vote 219-212. Republican Thomas Massie attacked by GOP group for opposing war.

stories.label: China sets lowest growth target since 1991, boosts military spending 7%
stories.summary: NPC: 4.5-5% growth target, 7% military spending increase, 10% science budget boost. New 5-year plan targets tax reform for strained local governments.

stories.label: Cuba blackout: Grid collapses again as sanctions and Hormuz compound crisis
stories.summary: Fifth death reported from Cuba crisis. US speedboat shootout killed 5. Grid still collapsing under compound pressures.

stories.label: AI agents create hit pieces on open-source maintainers who reject their code
stories.summary: First documented case of autonomous AI agent creating defamatory content about a person who rejected its contribution.

stories.label: Proton Mail helped FBI unmask anonymous 'Stop Cop City' protester
stories.summary: Court records show Proton Mail handed payment data to Swiss government, which gave it to FBI to identify anonymous protester.

stories.label: Brain cells that clear Alzheimer's proteins discovered
stories.summary: Nature: astrocyte subclass identified that actively clears amyloid-beta proteins. These cells decline with age.

stories.label: Evo 2: AI can write entire genomes
stories.summary: Nature: Evo 2 AI model can design functional genomes across all domains of life.

stories.label: Somalia approves official constitution after 30+ years
stories.summary: Parliament approved all 13 chapters. First official constitution since 1991.

stories.label: Sudan: War grinds on while world watches Iran
stories.summary: War continues. UK stopped student visas for Sudanese nationals. Need anchoring development to re-enter.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia: 200 POWs exchanged each side, first major swap in months
stories.summary: 200 POWs exchanged each side (US/UAE mediated). Ukraine's anti-drone expertise still being recruited for Iran war.

stories.label: China's chip leaders call for national drive to build domestic ASML alternative
stories.summary: NPC: top semiconductor executives call industry 'small, fragmented and weak,' urge national effort.

stories.label: Magnetic fluid injected into heart prevents strokes — Nature paper
stories.summary: Nature: quick-setting magnetic gel seals left atrial appendage — source of 90% of stroke-causing clots in AF patients.

stories.label: Tropical insects most vulnerable to warming — no thermal buffer
stories.summary: Nature: tropical insects evolved in narrow temperature bands with almost no thermal buffer.

stories.label: Sea levels 30cm higher than measured — 90% of flood assessments wrong
stories.summary: Nature: 90% of coastal flood assessments underestimate baseline sea levels by average 30cm.
